## graveyard_card

A card in a graveyard (any player's, in seat order; restrict with `controller` for its owner and `any_of`/`not` for its card types).

Rules: CR 404.1, CR 115.1

```json

  "graveyard_card": {
    "any_of": [

    ]
  }
}
```
